stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Learning was no longer only about correct answers.”?
options: It is also about where people stopped.
Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.
People enter more easily when the door connects to something they already care about.
It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.
